description: Use for one calendar year of Binance announcements. For the last 48 hours use get_latest_announcements. One year of exchange announcements with categories, trading pairs and timestamps: returns a JSON object with count and items. Call without payment to see the price and matching count; pay to get the records. Parameters combine as filters: year: required YYYY from 2017; market_catalogue.announcement_years lists available years; coin: optional case-insensitive ticker; call list_supported_coins or GET /v1/coins for recent labels; event: optional listings or delistings. Costs $0.25 USDC via x402; without payment returns an offer. No account or API key required. USDC on Base or Solana. Invalid, empty or stale requests are refused before payment. Retrying the same payment reuses a remembered settlement when its record is available; availability is not guaranteed.

coin.description: Optional ticker such as BTC, ETH, NVDA or EURUSD, matched against the AI-tagged coins and the tickers named in each record. Call list_supported_coins or GET /v1/coins for recent labels.

event.description: Optional: listings keeps new tokens, new trading pairs and futures launches; delistings keeps token delistings and trading pair removals.

year.description: A calendar year from 2017, YYYY. The free market_catalogue tool lists the years on sale in announcement_years (also GET /health).

name: get_announcement_history
title: Pay: Annual announcement history
